senses.gloss:
mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Cut, divided.
f. (-न्ना)
1 A whore, a harlot.
2 A tree: see गुडूची.
E.
छिद to cut, affix क्त, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Cut a little, incised, not cut off.
E.
कन् added to छिन्न.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं)
Having the ears cut off.
E.
छिन्न, and कर्ण the ear.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Shorn, shaven.
E.
छिन्न, and केश the hair.

m. (-न्वा)
A warrior whose bow has been cut or broken by his enemy's arrow.
E.
छिन्न, and धन्वन् a bow.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Noseless, having had the nose cut off.
E.
छिन्न, and नासिका the nose.

mfn. (स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Having the rope that passes through the nose of a draft ox broken.
E.
छिन्न, and नास्य the nose-rein.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Loosed, liberated.
E.
छिन्न, and बन्धन binding.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Cut up, destroyed, scattered.
E.
छिन्न, and भिन्न broken.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Decapitated.
f. (-स्ता)
A form of DURGĀ without her head.
E.
छिन्न, and मस्त the head; also with कन् added छिन्नभस्तक, छिन्नमस्तका.

f. (-हा)
A tree, (Menispermum glabrum): see गुडूची.
E.
छिन्न cut, and रुहा what grows; growing again after being cut.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having cut or cut off.
E.
छिन्न, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-का)
A plant, commonly Akaindhi, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
E.
छिन्न what is cut, (a wound,) and विश to enter, वुन् affix, and the fem. form.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Confirmed, confident, free from doubt.
E.
छिन्न, and संशय doubt.
